tasks.gr9-synoptic-revision-t4: Topic: Synoptic revision. Cover all genres from the year, comprehension strategies (skimming, scanning, inference), summary skills, evidence selection, and mixed-paper items. Ask Grade 9 learners to review genres across the curriculum, apply reading strategies strategically, summarise main ideas accurately, select and use relevant evidence effectively, and respond to exam-style questions across genres.
tasks.gr9-examination-writing-practice-t4: Topic: Examination writing practice. Cover letters and essays, planning and editing strategies, timed response production, format recall, and editing for common errors. Ask Grade 9 learners to produce accurate extended and transactional pieces under time pressure, plan essays before writing, recall correct letter and essay formats, manage time across multiple exam sections, and edit for grammar, spelling, and logic.
tasks.gr9-grammar-literature-consolidation-t4: Topic: Grammar and literature consolidation. Cover integrated language revision, literary themes across texts, vocabulary in context, and integrated MCQ and contextual question formats. Ask Grade 9 learners to draw together language and literature knowledge for final assessment, link grammar choices to literary effect, recognise recurring themes, answer integrated questions connecting technique to meaning, and justify interpretations with textual proof.
